name: ChrisPirillo/printfarmville
description: Manage a high-stakes 3D printing farm in Printfarmville. Monitor printers, fix nozzle clogs, and handle alerts in this optimized arcade simulation.

name: ChrisPirillo/panic-command
description: Engage with Panic Command, a procedural terminal hacking simulator. Experience a retro-futuristic CRT interface with real-time code generation, kernel panic simulations, and interactive security bypass sequences.

name: ChrisPirillo/maze-craze
description: Explore Maze Craze, an immersive procedural raymarching visualization featuring generative Truchet tiling. Experience real-time WebGL geometry with customizable tunnel height, wall thickness, and glow intensity.

name: ChrisPirillo/linky-dinks
description: Explore Linky Dinks, an immersive WebGL generative art experience. Create, customize, and export stunning recursive geometry patterns and 4K fractal wallpapers in real-time.

name: ChrisPirillo/geosplash
description: Geosplash is an immersive kinetic grid generator that creates hypnotic, algorithmically-driven visual patterns. Customize geometry, physics, and color palettes to generate unique digital art or 4K wallpapers.

name: ChrisPirillo/everline-forest
description: Everline Forest, an immersive procedural art engine. Explore an infinite, atmospheric generative landscape with customizable recursive depth, snowfall density, and shifting color palettes. Built for high-performance visual relaxation.

name: ChrisPirillo/dot-matrix
description: Dot Matrix is an interactive 5x7 bitmap generative typography engine. Create custom digital art with adjustable geometry, aesthetics, and real-time effects.

name: ChrisPirillo/crows-cache
description: A free retro arcade game. Catch falling oranges dropped by a mischievous crow in this pixel-art browser game. Test your reflexes and save the loot!

name: ChrisPirillo/computer-outerface
description: Computer Outerface is a generative interactive art installation and digital face engine. Create unique, stylized computer personalities with customizable eyes, pupils, eyebrows, and mouths. Features real-time microphone reactivity, breathing animations, and 4K wallpaper export capabilities.

name: ChrisPirillo/column-cascade
description: Column Cascade, a high-performance neural geometry visualizer. Explore infinite fractal columns, procedural distortions, and real-time WebGL art.

name: ChrisPirillo/cell-soul
description: Cell Soul is an immersive, real-time procedural simulator of Mammatus clouds. Explore organic atmospheric formations through cellular noise, domain warping, and dynamic lighting controls directly in your browser.

name: ChrisPirillo/carrot-critter
description: Dodge falling garden rakes and pull ripe carrots in Carrot Critter, a fast-paced retro arcade game. Test your reflexes as a nimble bunny in this high-score challenge.

name: ChrisPirillo/snubbles
description: Snubbles is a high-precision generative formula visualizer that creates stunning abstract art using mathematical precision. Experiment with complexity, tuning, and density to generate unique digital masterpieces.

name: ChrisPirillo/santas-blitz
description: Santa's Blitz is an addictive, holiday-themed match-3 arcade game. Match ornaments, trees, and wreaths to score points and climb the leaderboard in this festive winter challenge.

name: ChrisPirillo/node-moe
description: Node Moe is a high-performance interactive network visualizer and dynamic particle engine. Customize geometry, physics, and post-processing optics in real-time to create stunning generative art.

name: ChrisPirillo/midi-mixer
description: MIDI Mixer is a high-performance, generative MIDI studio and synth engine. Create, randomize, and export professional MIDI sequences and WAV audio directly in your browser with vintage CRT aesthetics.

name: ChrisPirillo/lumina-bubble
description: Lumina Bubble is a high-performance hex-grid ballistics arcade game. Strategically clear the matrix in this immersive bubble shooter featuring glowing physics and retro-futuristic visuals.

name: ChrisPirillo/liquid-evolution
description: Liquid Evolution, a high-performance interactive 3D generative sphere. Customize colors, noise distortion, and geometry evolution speed in real-time. Designed by Chris Pirillo.

name: ChrisPirillo/joy-field
description: Experience Joy Field, a sophisticated generative art engine. Interact with 3D procedural geometries including Mobius strips, DNA helices, and vortex fields using Three.js and GLSL shaders. Features real-time physics, audio reactivity, and 4K export capabilities.

name: ChrisPirillo/jaws
description: Test your nerves in Jaws, a high-stakes retro arcade game. Carefully remove swallowed junk from the shark's mouth before the timer runs out and the jaws snap shut! A precision-based browser experience.

name: ChrisPirillo/gesture-blaster
description: Experience Gesture Blaster, a high-intensity gesture-controlled arcade game. Use hand tracking technology to aim and zap targets in real-time. Created by Chris Pirillo.

name: ChrisPirillo/fish-frenzy
description: Play Fish Frenzy, an intense underwater arcade survival game. Eat smaller fish to grow, dodge deadly sharks, and rule the ocean. Created by Chris Pirillo.

name: ChrisPirillo/block-blast
description: Play Block Blast, the ultimate precision-based block puzzle royale. Strategy meets arcade action in this addictive puzzle game. Drag blocks to clear lines, boost your score, and master the grid.

name: ChrisPirillo/beneath-air
description: Experience Beneath Air, a high-performance interactive fractal visualizer. Explore infinite Mandelbox variations, customize mathematical parameters in real-time, and export stunning 4K wallpapers. A masterclass in WebGL performance and vibe coding.
